# CCZ MOD Knowledge Base

Read in this order:

1. 00-共性知识/README.md
2. Select one version: 6.5/README.md, 6.5pl/README.md, or 6.6/README.md
3. Use index.json to find canonical topic entries
4. Use 90-来源归档 only for evidence and provenance

Never apply an address, resource offset, table layout, or injection rule across versions without an explicit evidence entry.
